axes.population: Audience geography as measured by source, not inferred from content language
Creator-country eligibility and legal conditions, distinct from viewer origin
AdSense payment account and payout rules, not automatically creator audience
Market of the advertiser or matched inventory; separate revenue denominator
Audio, subtitle and metadata language; never a residency or sensitive demographic proxy

branches.title: Global source-specific scope
branches.population: GWI surveyed internet users age 16+ in defined covered markets and separate official platform activity events
branches.limitations: Including vs excluding China/Russia changes the survey denominator. Uploads and Shorts plays are events, not unique people.

branches.title: United States
branches.population: Pew U.S. adult survey and distinct DataReportal advertising reach
branches.limitations: Surveyed adult usage is not advertiser reach, a creator census or per-channel income.

branches.title: United Kingdom
branches.population: Ofcom UK adults, TV-set and in-home viewing under source-specific definitions
branches.limitations: TV time is already inside all-device in-home viewing; online reach and age 75+ weekly reach have different denominators.

branches.title: Mexico
branches.population: DataReportal advertising-reach estimate and separately documented creator product access
branches.limitations: YPP availability does not confirm access to every product, approved account status or typical local earnings.

branches.title: Reuters 48 online news markets
branches.population: Digital News Report 2026 quota-sampled online respondents from 48 markets
branches.limitations: Nonprobability online news survey with different coverage by market; not a worldwide audience census.

cross_region_rules: Preserve population, sampling method, age, time window, geography, device and definition with every estimate.
Do not add TV-set minutes to total in-home device minutes or sum overlapping content communities.
Do not treat ad reach, online survey respondents, upload counts, Shorts views or channel counts as unique viewers.
General YPP country availability does not confirm individual approval or every paid feature.
Do not infer creator residence, audience country, ethnicity or affiliation from language.
Unmeasured geographies, populations and earnings remain unknown, not zero.
